This land no be my own, na rent I rent am, so I no go waste money put plenty chemical fertilizer inside. For my yam and cassava, the bush dey fertile small and I go put the goat droppings and house refuse wey I gather. I go use the cuttings and seed yam wey I keep from last year — na the local one wey I sabi well. For this small plot, me and my wife go do most of the work, but I go call two-three people help me clear the bush and make the heaps because that work too hard for one man.
